description: This file defines the interface for a simplistic hash map implementation in C, including functions for creating, cloning, destroying, inserting, retrieving, and iterating over hash map entries. It also provides iterator mechanisms for traversing the hash map.

classes.name: icHashMap
classes.description: Opaque structure representing the hash map.

classes.name: icHashMapIterator
classes.description: Structure used for iterating over hash map entries.

methods.name: hashMapIteratorDestroy__auto
methods.description: Helper for automatic cleanup of hash map iterators using AUTO_CLEAN macro.
